question:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
Fear of ugliness.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Cacophobia)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Cacophobia"** refers to the fear of ugliness. It is derived from the Greek words "kakos" meaning bad or ugly and "phobos" meaning fear. (काकोफोबिया: कुरूपता का डर)
 
 
• **Example:** People with cacophobia may avoid certain situations or people they perceive as unattractive due to their overwhelming fear.
 
 
• Understanding the fear of ugliness is important as it may stem from societal or psychological factors.
